content.title: Performed Competence Mishap | Witnessed Failure and Social Recovery
content.summary: Establish an adult performer intentionally showing competence to an adult familiar observer. One escalating movement phrase causes exactly one fully visible mishap; the observer reacts first, then a restrained recovery gesture closes the embarrassment while both roles remain spatially connected.

quick_start.input_format: two clearly adult original roles, shared sightline and deliberate competence-display intent + one continuous movement phrase visibly escalates + exactly one causally readable mistake shows balance loss, impact and consequence + observer reacts first + performer acknowledges failure with one brief self-conscious recovery gesture + both roles remain spatially connected at the held ending
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult bicycle courier demonstrates a one-handed scan-and-mount routine to an adult dispatcher, catches the front wheel on one soft parking stop, lands on a padded parcel mat, then accepts help and straightens the bent scanner strap with an embarrassed grin.
required_anchors: Establish two clearly adult original roles, a shared sightline and the performer's deliberate competence-display intent before the risky move.
Build one continuous movement phrase whose amplitude or difficulty visibly increases.
Let the observer react before the performer begins the social recovery.
End on one restrained recovery gesture that acknowledges failure while both roles remain spatially connected.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish an adult performer intentionally showing competence to an adult familiar observer. One escalating movement phrase causes exactly one fully visible mishap; the observer reacts first, then a restrained recovery gesture closes the embarrassment while both roles remain spatially connected.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult performer, one original clearly adult familiar observer, a shared sightline and one simple open action area. Make the performer intentionally display competence through a continuous escalating movement phrase while the observer remains visibly attentive. Introduce exactly one readable physical mistake caused by the established movement, then show loss of balance, impact and immediate consequence without skipping the causal middle. Let the observer respond first with restrained concern or amusement, and let the performer complete one brief self-conscious recovery gesture that acknowledges the failed display. The reusable mechanism is witnessed self-presentation, escalating confidence, one causally legible mishap, consequence, social response and embarrassment recovery—not the source characters, faces, hair, clothing, franchise, flower grove, exact poses, fall choreography, composition, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish two clearly adult original roles, a shared sightline and the performer's deliberate competence-display intent before the risky move.
invariants.purpose: Makes the accident reverse a social goal rather than appear as random slapstick.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a witnessed display intention, the fall has no status reversal.

invariants.rule: Build one continuous movement phrase whose amplitude or difficulty visibly increases.
invariants.purpose: Creates a physical cause for overconfidence and keeps the setup compact.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated tricks make the eventual mistake arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Use exactly one mistake and show balance loss, impact and immediate consequence without a causal gap.
invariants.purpose: Preserves readable physics and concentrates the comic beat.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple accidents or a cut directly to the ground weaken causality.

invariants.rule: Let the observer react before the performer begins the social recovery.
invariants.purpose: Makes the embarrassment depend on being seen.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the performer recovers before the observer responds, the relationship contributes nothing.

invariants.rule: End on one restrained recovery gesture that acknowledges failure while both roles remain spatially connected.
invariants.purpose: Converts a physical gag into a reusable social closure.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending at impact leaves the relationship and emotional payoff unfinished.

the source creator identity, MiniMax H3 attribution wording and 10-second timing
